caption: Compare the four counters left to right. The row with one id beats the row with one class, even though both add to the same total, and the inline style wins on the first counter alone.

spec.title: Specificity as four counters: inline, id, class, element
spec.aria: Five selectors with their four specificity counters; the id counter of #intro p is set, and the inline-style row wins on the first counter.
